# 发展负责任的人工智能：新一代人工智能治理原则发布

Ministry of Science and Technology of the PRC (MOST), June 17, 2019. Full text of the 《新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能》(New-Generation AI Governance Principles — Developing Responsible AI), issued by the National New-Generation AI Governance Committee (国家新一代人工智能治理专业委员会).

## Key findings (full text)
- Issued **June 17, 2019** by the 国家新一代人工智能治理专业委员会 (National New-Generation AI Governance Committee), established by the New-Generation AI Development Plan Promotion Office.
- Drafting involved online public comment solicitation, repeated expert discussion, and multi-party consultation.
- **Eight principles** (八条原则):
  1. **和谐友好 (Harmonious & friendly)** — AI should aim at增进人类共同福祉 (advancing common human well-being); conform to human values and ethics; promote human-machine harmony; safeguard social security and human rights; avoid misuse; prohibit abuse/malicious use.
  2. **公平公正 (Fair & just)** — promote fairness and justice, protect stakeholders' rights, promote equal opportunity; eliminate bias and discrimination across data acquisition, algorithm design, development, product R&D, and application.
  3. **包容共享 (Inclusive & shared)** — promote green/environmentally friendly development; coordinated development across industries and regions; inclusive development (AI education, lifting vulnerable groups, closing the digital divide); shared development (avoid data/platform monopoly, encourage open and orderly competition).
  4. **尊重隐私 (Respect privacy)** — respect and protect personal privacy; guarantee individuals' right to know and right to choose; set boundaries and norms across collection, storage, processing, and use of personal information; improve data authorization/revocation mechanisms; oppose theft, tampering, leakage, and other illegal collection/use of personal information.
  5. **安全可控 (Safe & controllable)** — continuously improve transparency, explainability, reliability, and controllability; progressively achieve auditable, supervisable, traceable, and trustworthy systems; focus on AI system security; improve robustness and anti-interference; build AI security assessment and control capabilities.
  6. **共担责任 (Shared responsibility)** — developers, users, and other stakeholders should bear social responsibility and self-discipline; strictly observe laws, ethics, and standards; establish AI accountability mechanisms clarifying the responsibilities of developers, users, and beneficiaries; ensure human right-to-know, inform of possible risks and impacts; prevent illegal use of AI.
  7. **开放协作 (Open collaboration)** — encourage cross-disciplinary, cross-domain, cross-regional, and cross-border exchange and cooperation; promote coordinated interaction among international organizations, governments, research institutions, educational institutions, enterprises, social organizations, and the public; conduct international dialogue and cooperation; on the premise of fully respecting each country's AI governance principles and practices, promote forming a broadly consensual international AI governance framework and standards.
  8. **敏捷治理 (Agile governance)** — respect the laws of AI development; while promoting innovative and orderly development, timely identify and resolve possible risks; continuously improve intelligent technical means, optimize management mechanisms, and improve the governance system; carry the governance principles through the full lifecycle of AI products and services; continuously research and forecast the potential risks of future more advanced AI, ensuring AI always develops in a direction beneficial to humanity.
